name: 文体计量分析
description: Analyzes writing style features to detect AI-generated text through stylistic fingerprinting.
useCase: Identifying AI-generated text by analyzing writing style characteristics unique to human authors
mechanism: Extracts stylometric features including sentence structure patterns, punctuation usage, paragraph organization, rhetorical devices, and discourse markers. Human writing exhibits consistent personal style signatures, while AI text shows characteristic patterns of the generating model — often more formal, structured, and lacking personal quirks.
source: Uchendu et al. (2020) - Authorship Attribution for Neural Text Generation, EMNLP
algorithm: Stylometric Feature Extraction + Statistical Pattern Classification + Discourse Analysis
parameters: Features: 50+ stylistic markers, Min length: 200 words, Analysis: n-gram distribution, function word frequency, readability indices
strengths:
• Captures deep writing style patterns
• Effective on longer documents
• Can distinguish between different AI models
• Robust against simple paraphrasing
limitations:
• Requires sufficient text length for reliable analysis
• Multi-author texts are challenging
• Professional editing can mask style signals
• Style varies by genre and context

references.title: Uchendu, A. et al. (2020). Authorship Attribution for Neural Text Generation. EMNLP.
